name: bug

description: Finding class 4/10: High-level credibility, governance, or scientific-framing flaw

description: Finding class 5/10: Risk or sensitivity worth bounding/monitoring

description: Finding class 7/10: Direct contradiction between documents, specs, or versions

name: gap
description: Finding class 8/10: Missing required artifact, test category, or checklist item

name: hole
description: Finding class 9/10: Structural weakness in a verification or security check

name: blindspot
description: Finding class 10/10: Unexamined assumption or untested invariant class
